reason: The VAT e-invoice is the actual reason: our accountant keeps bouncing my English OpenAI receipts, and if it's really the official price at the bank rate I lose nothing by switching part of our spend. would_change_my_mind: If the first VAT invoice came out wrong or the receipts showed a different model than I asked for, I'd go straight back to paying OpenAI by card.
